author: ClaudeDevs
bio: Official updates for developers building with @ClaudeAI
text:
Opus 5.5 performs at the level of Fable 5.1. It's ~30% faster and ~40% cheaper than Opus 5 per task.

In Claude Code:
- 5-hour session limits increase 20% today
- Opus 5.5 is priced lower, so it goes 25% further within limits
- Pro, Max, and Team users get a reset to use anytime https://t.co/1seRYKAtzJ

Introducing Claude Opus 5.5, the first model in our new Claude 5.5 family.
